commands.review_summary:
Adds browser startup detection that switches ChatGPT Work-mode pages and non-resume Work conversations into Chat before model and effort selection.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main has no Chat/Work startup gate, the supplied live runs demonstrate the root cases, and Oracle’s existing URL helpers provide a high-confidence project-scoped path that exercises the uncovered branch.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The blocker is a narrow, mechanical conversation-path repair with clear implementation files and validation steps.

target.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat
target.body:
Closes #315.

## Motivation

ChatGPT now exposes separate `Chat` and `Work` modes. Both render a usable composer, so `ensurePromptReady` alone cannot tell whether a new Oracle browser run is about to perform ordinary Chat model/effort selection in the Work UI.

This is a standalone browser compatibility enhancement. It is independent of GPT-5.6 model aliases and picker behavior, and distinct from #308's Cloudflare classification fix.

## Design

- Probe the exact visible `Chat` / `Work` radio controls before model or effort selection.
- Switch Work to Chat through trusted CDP mouse input, verify the selected state, and re-wait for the replacement composer.
- Classify attached conversation tabs after their active history metadata hydrates.
- Reset a non-resume attachment to a new Chat when the current conversation is Work.
- Fail closed for an explicit resume of a Work conversation instead of silently abandoning the requested thread.
- Preserve compatibility with older layouts when Chat/Work controls and metadata are absent.
- Apply the same normalization to local and remote-Chrome browser paths.

Rebased onto current `main`, including the merged GPT-5.6 unified-picker work from #304.

## Validation

Exact final head: `0d37a7f138890fbf921cd3c614f1dd7bdfcf14b1`.

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/pageActions.test.ts tests/browser/index.test.ts` — 134 passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm check` — passed.
- `pnpm build` — passed.
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` — 1,509 passed, 44 skipped. The excluded profile-copy test requires system `rsync`.

## Exact-head live proof

A signed-in browser profile was validated in both representative states after the rebase.

### Work selected on the home page

```text
ChatGPT mode: Work; switching to Chat
ChatGPT mode: Chat (switched from Work)
Prompt textarea ready
Clicked send button
Answer:
PR316_REBASED_CHAT_OK
```

Completed in 13.4 seconds.

### Attached existing Work conversation

```text
ChatGPT mode: Work conversation; opening a new Chat
Navigating to https://chatgpt.com/
ChatGPT mode: Chat (switched from Work)
Prompt textarea ready
Clicked send button
Answer:
PR316_REBASED_WORK_TAB_OK
```

Completed in 14.6 seconds.

Neither run clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control. Profile identifiers, target IDs, local paths, ports, authentication data, and conversation URLs are redacted.
